content.title: About
content.content: Cod liver oil is a dietary supplement derived from the liver of cod fish (Gadus species). Unlike standard fish oils extracted from body tissues, cod liver oil is uniquely high in preformed vitamin A and vitamin D alongside long-chain omega-3 fatty acids EPA and DHA.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: It has been used for centuries in Scandinavian countries to preserve health during dark winters.
Contains preformed vitamin D3, crucial for bone density and immune function.
Historical standard prevention method against childhood rickets.
Unique dual profile of essential vitamins (A & D) combined with marine omega-3s.
Modern processing removes heavy metals and environmental toxins.

items.title: Bone & Immune Support
items.content: Vitamin D aids calcium absorption and immune system readiness.

items.title: Vision & Skin Health
items.content: Vitamin A maintains healthy skin tissue and nocturnal vision.

items.title: Cardiovascular Health
items.content: EPA and DHA support healthy triglyceride levels and arterial function.

items.title: Anti-Inflammatory
items.content: Omega-3s help reduce systemic inflammation throughout the body.

items.title: Vitamin A Toxicity Risk
items.content: Excessive doses can lead to hypervitaminosis A; pregnant women should follow strict dosage guidance.

items.title: Blood Thinning Effect
items.content: High omega-3 doses may increase bleeding risk when taken with blood thinners.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Take as a liquid spoon dose or softgel capsule with a meal containing fats to optimize vitamin absorption.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Refrigerate liquid cod liver oil immediately after opening and consume within 2-3 months to maintain freshness.
